title: wg: virtual-clients-01 L724 Under extensions-10 §4.9, SafeAAD framing applies only if the...
description:
draft-ietf-mls-virtual-clients (virtual-clients-01), Virtual client actions. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-virtual-clients at 65e960d, L724.

Text: "The SafeAAD component data of the
`virtual_clients` component is a VirtualClientAction struct."

Problem: Under extensions-10 §4.9, SafeAAD framing applies only if the emulation group's GroupContext app_data_dictionary contains a safe_aad component. The draft never requires the emulation group to carry safe_aad listing virtual_clients when actions are used.

Suggested fix: State that an emulation group that uses virtual client actions MUST include safe_aad, listing virtual_clients, in its GroupContext app_data_dictionary.

Severity: low. Verifier: narrow (extensions-10 §4.9 frames authenticated_data as SafeAAD only when safe_aad is present in the GroupContext's app_data_dictionary. The draft never requires that for the emulation group. The LeafNode-capabilities part is dropped, because RFC 9420 leaf validation already requires listed extensions. The 'raw VCA in AAD' reading is weak, because L724 explicitly says SafeAAD component data.)
